data.description: Color printing reached a level of perfection in the early 1600s, as seen in this Ten Bamboo Studio Collection of Calligraphy and Painting. The painterly quality (printing that looks like painting), precision in registering (aligning) the woodblocks, and harmonious colors made them some of the most successful color print editions in Chinese history. Printed and compiled in Nanjing, spread nationwide, the compendium had a great impact on the arts in Japan and Korea.
